document-view._comment: Static (eager) client JS+CSS a first-time visitor of a published document page downloads before any interaction. Was 1265369 B RAW (no compression at all) before #cee667d8; is 83835 B gzip after the fix (lazy hljs/katex/marked + Caddy encode) — ceiling set ~19% above that measured value, not at the task's looser 300KB target, per the ratchet rule (lower the ceiling to match reality, don't leave headroom for its own sake).

home._comment: Homepage — no markdown/mermaid/katex/hljs on this route at all. Measured 72997 B gzip after #cee667d8; ceiling ~23% above that.

document-view-nested._comment: Folder-share nested document route — same MarkdownViewer as document-view but a DISTINCT compiled leaf in the build manifest, so a regression introduced directly in this route file wouldn't be caught by document-view's entry alone. Measured 79620 B gzip after #cee667d8; ceiling ~19% above that, per the same ratchet rule as document-view/home.
